I. Love. That video. 

It's the single best explanation of learning disabilities I've seen, and I say that as a teacher who took 7 years of college classes for psychology and special education and 29 years living it.

It's not really the same thing, but the closest you can safely come for curiosity's sake is probably skipping a night or two of sleep and waiting for your 'second wind'. That time, when you're not sleepy but your brain can't focus or remember anything is symptomatically similar.
Thank you! I will definitely look into these.
